name: Duplicate Post/Page with Find & Replace – Bulk Post Creator from CSV
author: Xfinitysoft

sections.description:
Quickly duplicate posts/pages with built‑in Find & Replace, or bulk‑create new posts from a CSV/TXT keyword list. Fast, safe, and SEO‑friendly.

Work faster, publish more, and keep your SEO clean.
This plugin combines two powerful tools into one:
1. Smart duplication with Find & Replace so you can update titles, slugs, content, and links as you clone.
2. Bulk post creation from a CSV/TXT keyword list — perfect for scaling content in minutes.

Whether you’re building location‑based service pages, product variations, or running a content campaign, this plugin saves hours of repetitive work.

Try the Demo | Documentation | Premium Version | Facebook Page

Key Features

  • 🔁 One‑click duplication for posts, pages, and custom post types
  • 📝 Find & Replace while cloning — update text, titles, slugs, and meta fields instantly
  • 📦 Bulk post generator — upload a CSV/TXT keyword list and auto‑create posts
  • 🧩 Custom post type support — works with listings, products, portfolios, and more
  • 📈 SEO‑smart — unique slugs, clean structure, no duplicate content issues
  • 🛡 Safe by design — originals remain untouched

Use Cases

  • Local SEO pages: “Service in {City}” for multiple locations
  • Product variations: change prices, SKUs, or regions in bulk
  • Landing page testing: duplicate and tweak headlines or CTAs
  • Campaign bursts: upload keywords and generate posts instantly

Free vs Pro Features

Free Version
– Duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types
– Choose what to duplicate (title, content, taxonomies, featured image, meta values)
– Find & Replace in title, slug, and content during duplication
– Add prefix/suffix to duplicated titles
– Role‑based access control
– Set duplicate post status (Draft/Published)
– Redirect after duplication (edit screen, front‑end, or none)

Pro Version (includes everything in Free, plus)
– Find & Replace in image ALT tags and meta values
– Case‑sensitive Find & Replace option
– Bulk duplication of multiple posts/pages with meta data (Elementor compatible)
– Advanced bulk creation from CSV/TXT with extended field mapping
– Priority support & updates

► Report Bugs/Issues
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Access duplication and bulk creation tools from your post/page list or admin menu.
  3. Configure Find & Replace rules or upload your CSV keyword file.
sections.faq:
Does it work with custom post types?

Yes, it supports most custom post types.

Can I update titles and slugs during duplication?

Yes, you can replace text in titles, slugs, content, and meta fields.

Is it SEO‑friendly?

Yes — you can create unique titles, slugs, and content to avoid duplicate content issues.
